style: An oil painting of 1893 in the manner of Victorian narrative painting. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

people.mina: Mina Harker, a young dark-haired Englishwoman of about twenty-five, hair pinned up, a plain dark dress with a white high collar; no mark on her face
people.seward: Dr John Seward, a doctor of about thirty, dark hair, bare clean-shaven face with no beard, no moustache and no spectacles, dark frock coat
people.jonathan: Jonathan Harker, a grown man of twenty-six with snow-white hair and a young clean-shaven face, dark suit
people.arthur: Arthur Holmwood, Lord Godalming, a tall young English nobleman of about thirty, dark curly hair, clean-shaven, in black mourning clothes
people.quincey: Quincey Morris, a tall lean Texan of about thirty with a moustache, in a travelling coat and wide hat
people.vh: Professor Van Helsing, a stocky elderly Dutch doctor of about sixty, grey hair, bare clean-shaven face with no beard and no moustache, dark frock coat

beats.text: Shot: close. Close: the young woman lays her hand on the doctor's hand on the table and speaks gravely; warm lamplight on the two hands and her face.
Shot: medium. The young woman lies back in her chair, pale and spent, the phonograph earpieces in her lap; the doctor has jumped up with a horrified face and pours brandy from a decanter.
